fields.display_title: The authors propose solving the task of action localization by using a multi-stage cross attention to build a shared representation of audio and visual embeddings followed by an open-max classifier to properly handle no-action cases. They perform an extensive comparison with other recent state-of-the-art models and an ablation study, proving the validity of the proposed method.
